articles.title: Data Protection Board Initiates Full Enforcement of Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act
articles.summary: The Data Protection Board of India begins full-scale enforcement of data fiduciary obligations and citizen privacy rights under the DPDP framework.
prelims: Data Protection Board of India functions as an independent, digital-by-design adjudication body.
Categorizes entities into Data Fiduciaries and Significant Data Fiduciaries based on volume and risk of personal data processed.
Grants specific exemptions for government research, statistical gathering, and public order considerations under statutory safeguards.
articles.mains: Examine how the enforcement framework of the DPDP Act balances individual privacy rights with innovation in India's expanding digital economy.

articles.title: Deep Ocean Mission: Indigenous Submersible MATSYA 6000 Completes Deep-Sea Trials
articles.summary: India's human-crewed submersible MATSYA 6000 successfully achieves operational targets during ocean-depth validation trials.
prelims: Nodal Ministry: Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES), implemented via the National Institute of Ocean Technology (NIOT).
Designed to transport 3 crew members to a maximum depth of 6,000 meters under the Samudrayaan project.
Aims to facilitate non-invasive exploration of polymetallic nodules, hydrothermal sulfides, and cobalt crusts in the Central Indian Ocean.
articles.mains: Discuss the strategic and economic significance of India's Deep Ocean Mission in fostering sustainable growth under the Blue Economy policy.

articles.title: IMEC Strategic Working Group Advances Digital Trade and Rail Interoperability Protocols
articles.summary: Partner countries of the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) finalize unified digital customs and infrastructure standards.
prelims: IMEC consists of the East Corridor connecting India to the Arabian Gulf and the Northern Corridor linking the Gulf to Europe.
Integrates multimodal transit infrastructure alongside clean hydrogen pipelines and high-capacity undersea optical fiber cables.
Launched originally on the sidelines of the G20 New Delhi Leaders' Summit.
articles.mains: Analyze the geopolitical and trade implications of IMEC as an alternative resilient supply chain corridor connecting Asia and Europe.

articles.title: National Green Hydrogen Mission Achieves 5 GW Domestic Electrolyser Capacity Target
articles.summary: India hits a major clean energy milestone as domestic manufacturing under the SIGHT scheme scales up to meet industrial hydrogen demands.
prelims: SIGHT (Strategic Interventions for Green Hydrogen Transition) provides financial incentives for electrolyser manufacturing and green hydrogen production.
Nodal Ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE).
Target: Production of at least 5 Million Metric Tonnes (MMT) of Green Hydrogen per annum by 2030.
articles.mains: Evaluate the technological and logistical challenges in decarbonizing hard-to-abate industrial sectors through green hydrogen adoption in India.

articles.title: Global Biofuel Alliance Releases Harmonized Standards for Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF)
articles.summary: The Global Biofuel Alliance publishes global technical guidelines to accelerate commercialization of second-generation (2G) bio-jet fuels.
prelims: Global Biofuel Alliance (GBA) was led by India, Brazil, and the United States to promote sustainable biofuel adoption.
Emphasizes non-food feedstock such as agricultural residues, municipal solid waste, and algae to prevent food security conflicts.
Supports the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) targets for reducing aviation carbon emissions.
articles.mains: How can the Global Biofuel Alliance assist developing nations in achieving net-zero aviation targets without impacting food security and land resources?
